description: This file defines the 'DishIngredient' result class for the Coocook schema, representing ingredients associated with dishes in a database. It includes table definitions, relationships to other entities (article, dish, unit, item), and methods for managing ingredient data, such as assigning to purchase lists and updating values.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::DishIngredient
classes.description: Represents a dish ingredient with properties like quantity, associated article, unit, and relationships to other entities. Provides methods for managing ingredient data and conversions.

methods.name: assign_to_purchase_list
methods.description: Assigns the dish ingredient to a purchase list by creating or retrieving an item and linking it.

methods.name: delete_update_item
methods.description: Deletes the ingredient and updates related item if necessary.

methods.name: set_value_update_item
methods.description: Updates the ingredient's value, adjusting the associated item and handling conversions.

methods.name: set_value_unit_update_item
methods.description: Updates the ingredient's value and unit, adjusting the associated item accordingly.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares data for editing ingredients, including available units and current properties.
